scope: Matched native input File reads of preserved 5 GiB payload, two fresh isolated Chrome instances. Prototype slice-arrayBuffer versus stream BYOB with recycled 4 MiB backing buffer. No production changes, OPFS source ownership change, forced collection during trial, transfer/LAN or release acceptance claim.
interpretation: A matched same-file readback experiment isolates allocation pressure from per-slice ArrayBuffers. Recycling BYOB backing storage substantially reduces sampled allocation without losing the exact hash. This is a prototype, not a production fix or proof of historical full-transfer root cause, all browser behavior or size-independent memory bounds.
